item.title: MiBeeReach: Remote Desktop, Terminal, SSH and Tunneling in One Binary
item.description: My complaints about commercial remote-access software are specific: the free tier throttles speed and caps hours, ads pop up on schedule, traffic flows through the vendor’s servers, and not one knob for image quality or latency belongs to me. I used Sunflower and ToDesk for a while and evaluated self-hosting RustDesk’s server edition before deciding to build one from zero. That is MiBeeReach: a single-binary remote access platform in Rust with remote desktop, remote terminal, remote SSH, tunneling, and cross-network P2P all inside. The name joins the MiBee brand with Reach — making any machine behind NAT reachable from outside, on your terms.
